picks.name: DJ Jeff the Lastborn
picks.source_note: New label discovery: Nyege Nyege Tapes. Similar percussive/ritual-electronic territory to your Nihiloxica and Jay Mitta picks.
picks.bio: "Kadodi Season Two" (September 18, 2026, Nyege Nyege Tapes) continues the Kadodi lineage -- ritual percussive music from Mbale, Uganda originally performed for circumcision rites and cultural gatherings, here brought into a contemporary electronic context. Limited to 99 copies on cassette with custom artwork.
picks.why_listen: Trance-inducing, transfixing percussion recontextualized with modern electronic production -- a genuinely unique texture for an adventurous stretch of a set.

picks.name: Hollen
picks.source_note: New label discovery: Children Of Tomorrow. Similar groove-forward techno territory to your Scuba and Answer Code Request picks.
picks.bio: "Warm Shuffle EP" (2026, Children Of Tomorrow Records) is a four-track release -- Warm Shuffle, Swinger, Symmetry, Dynamic Bell -- ranging from groovy tech house to peak-time techno across a 104-142 BPM spread.
picks.why_listen: Versatile, groove-driven techno that can flex from warm-up to peak time -- a practical, well-produced addition to a driving set.
